newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain share index rises 19.4 points in week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain share index rises 19.4 points in week.

text.p: Bahrain's shares index ended the week 19.4 points higher on Thursday amid a surge in trading focused on banks and investment firms, the Bahrain Monetary Agency said.
The index rose to 1,541.91 points from 1,522.51 points the previous week, the bourse said.
Around 11.4 million shares worth three million dinars ($7.96 million) changed hands in the week, sharply up from 6.7 million shares worth 1.55 million dinars a week ago.
Shares of 18 companies out of the 39 registered on the stock market were traded in 265 transactions.

The bourse said Investcorp led the market in terms of share value with 1.12 million shares worth 760,140 dinars changing hands. Its share price ended the week at $1.82, down from $1.83 a week earlier.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank came second with two million shares worth 642,649 dinars traded. Its share prices climbed 10 fils to 326 fils each.

Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors. ($1=0.377 dinar)
